title: The Silence That Was a Failure: A Link That Is Up and Says Nothing, and a Watchdog That Notices
fallback: This lesson is about noticing that something has stopped talking, so it needs Qt. Lesson 07-08 is about a loop that holds its rate and counts what it missed, and lesson 08-13 about a cable that comes out, in plain C++. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a watchdog that says whether a link is alive, late or lost from the age of the last heartbeat, with one event for each change
